speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) will nurture resilient individuals, strong families and a caring society.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Guided by family-centred, proactive and strengths-based approaches, we will give Singaporeans greater assurance throughout life’s journey.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MSF will support families through every life stage.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will invest in the professional development of EC educators and partner preschools to enable each child to achieve their potential.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will rally like-minded individuals, families and organisations to expand marriage and family programmes through the Families for Life (FFL) movement.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: For those facing family relationships challenges, MSF will develop accessible and affordable family counselling services.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: For Persons with Disabilities (PwDs), MSF will enhance employment support and opportunities for lifelong learning and strengthen home-based and community support to enable PwDs to live and participate fully in society.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will help families with PwDs prepare for needs across life stages through Person- and Family-centred Planning and foster positive attitudes towards PwDs.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We are committed to building a society where men and women stand as equals and can pursue their aspirations to the fullest.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will lead the whole-of-Government efforts to strengthen support for women in the family, workplace and society.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Together we will move towards a fairer and more inclusive society.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MSF will support lower-income families in gaining stability, self-reliance and social mobility.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also enhance the physical and digital delivery of services at Social Service Offices, while improving coordination with other public organisations and social service agencies.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The Family Services Review Committee, comprising senior leaders from the sector and MSF, is examining how we can deliver more holistic, family-centric services to improve outcomes for families with complex issues.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MSF will strengthen the National Council of Social Service’s role as a sector developer and support the sector in offering rewarding and meaningful careers to social service professionals.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also encourage the pervasive adoption of digital technology, including artificial intelligence, to enhance social services.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MSF will develop a comprehensive infrastructure plan for the next generation of social and residential services, making our services more accessible and fostering closer collaboration between social service agencies serving the same community.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will deepen our partnerships with research institutes and the innovation ecosystem in the social sciences and technology.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will strengthen regional and international collaboration to encourage the exchange of ideas, especially in the areas of family development and social mobility.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MSF alone cannot nurture strong families and build a caring society.
